# fingerprint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:fingerprint`](gmeow-fingerprint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/fingerprint>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/trust`](../../slices/trust.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A fingerprint (hash) identifying a key. Not functional: different sources may report differing or differently-formatted fingerprints for the same key.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:CryptographicKey`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicKey.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:fingerprint`](gmeow-fingerprint.md) from [`gmeow:CryptographicKey`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicKey.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record a key's fingerprint (hash) as reported by a source — the human-checkable identifier used to confirm a key out of band.

### Avoid when

- Avoid treating it as a single canonical value — sources report differing or differently-formatted fingerprints, so keep it non-functional and let competing source values coexist; for the short key id use [`gmeow:keyId`](gmeow-keyId.md).

### How to use

- Attach each source's fingerprint literal to the key; preserve the source's formatting verbatim and let multiple fingerprint claims coexist rather than collapsing them.

### Examples

- ex:lillithKey [`gmeow:fingerprint`](gmeow-fingerprint.md) "A1B2 C3D4 E5F6...".
